Hi! I am a PhD student in cognitive science at the [University of Potsdam](https://www.uni-potsdam.de) under the supervision of [Shravan Vasishth](https://vasishth.github.io) and [Ralf Engbert](https://www.uni-potsdam.de/de/expbiopsy/staff/ralf-engbert).

As part of [Project B03 of the Collaborative Research Centre 1287](https://www.sfb1287.uni-potsdam.de), I work on modeling eye-movement control during reading of complex sentences, using Bayesian statistics to fit and compare models.
